items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: There's hardly anyone in this world that plays them anymore outside of Barney Bigard and Procope.

ctx.x: At what age did you take a second instrument?

Well, when I graduated from junior high school in June the 27th, 1927, when I walked down the aisle, I was the last one in the class that walked down because alphabetically, there was nobody in the class with -- that came in my line after the R's, so I was the last one in my class to walk across the stage and out of the auditorium and when I got there, my uncle had a little box waiting for me and I asked him what it was and he says, 'This is your new clarinet.' So, I really didn't know anything about it. It was…
